title: Parliament's Monsoon Session Begins Today; Key Bills Lined Up
description: Parliament's Monsoon Session begins today and will run till 13 August. The 25-day session will have 19 sittings, during which the government is expected to introduce and seek passage of several key legislations.In the Lok Sabha today, the government is scheduled to take up the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026.
